explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/409: the page says the intended question is presumably to find 'good' upper bounds for F(n), and notes F(n) = o(n) is trivial. This variant asks for any g with c = O(g), which is trivially satisfiable (e.g. g(n) = n). The docstring admits it ('Trivial or sub-optimal solutions will therefore exist'). As a formal target it carries no content beyond the subjective 'simplest g', so it is weak as a formalisation of the problem.
